subject: Locked-down airgap: procurement clarifications & implementation plan
messages:
From: Patrick Miller <patrick.miller@clearlake-med.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Aaron Cho <aaron.cho@clearlake-med.com>, ClearLake Medical - Procurement <procurement@clearlake-med.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Locked-down airgap: procurement clarifications & implementation plan

Ben — thanks for the questionnaire draft. A few clarifications from procurement and our infrastructure team so we can finish the POC purchase order:

1) Operator access model: we need confirmation that operator activity is limited to the customer-controlled bastion. Can Redwood provide a signed attestation that no outbound call-home or telemetry leaves the isolated network unless explicitly configured for scheduled support windows?

2) Patch workflow: request more detail about offline patch delivery. We require signed patch artifacts plus an SBOM and verification steps for each patch. Can you attach a standard patch manifest format and signing instructions?

3) KMS/HSM: our security team prefers HSM-backed key wrap that never leaves our boundary. Will Redwood support local HSM integration for model encryption keys and for TLS termination (customer-managed)?

4) Support SLAs & escalation: procurement needs to see on-call windows and response times for escalations during initial 90-day onboarding. Is there a draft SLA we can review?

We're aiming to finalize scope and get a PO to procurement by 3/19.

Regards,
Patrick Miller
Director of Infrastructure & Security
ClearLake Medical
--
Attachment: clearlake_rfi_questions_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Patrick Miller <patrick.miller@clearlake-med.com>
Cc: Aaron Cho <aaron.cho@clearlake-med.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Locked-down airgap: procurement clarifications & implementation plan

Hi Patrick — appreciate the clear list. Quick responses inline, and attaching the completed questionnaire + a runbook draft for operator steps. We'll follow up with a signed attestation and a proposed SLA doc.

1) Operator access model: Redwood's private on-prem package runs with a two-party operator model when deployed air-gapped: (a) customer-managed bastion + operator accounts that are local to the customer AD/LDAP. By default our support personnel do not have remote access. For emergency support we propose a scheduled, customer-initiated access window (timeboxed) and recorded session logs exported to your SIEM. We will provide a signed attestation template for legal.

2) Patch workflow: we support offline patch bundles that are signed with our release GPG key. Each bundle includes an SBOM (CycloneDX JSON and human-readable manifest), a patch checklist, and verification scripts. You can validate signatures locally; hashes and signer certs will be provided in the bundle. See operator-runbook-draft.md (attached) for step-by-step apply/rollback.

3) KMS/HSM: We support integrating with customer HSMs (PKCS#11) for model key wrapping and store only encrypted blobs. For TLS termination, we can configure customer-managed certs and keys so private keys never leave the HSM. We list supported vendors (SafeHaven, FortKnox HSM, CloudHSM appliances) in the questionnaire.

4) Support SLAs & escalation: attaching a draft signed-sla-proposal.pdf with 90-day onboarding windows: 4-hour P1 response for critical on-call during onboarding, 24x7 paging for P1 after go-live under enterprise plan. We can offer an onboarding credit if we need a dedicated field engineer for on-prem.

Attachments: clearlake-airgap-questionnaire-complete.pdf, operator-runbook-draft.md, signed-sla-proposal.pdf

Next steps: Laura, can you confirm estimated field engineer days and cost? Irene, please prepare the attestation wording for sign-off. Vivek — any red flags on operator tooling or the HSM list? Patrick — if this looks aligned, we'll prepare a final SOW and DocuSign link by 3/11.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>, Patrick Miller <patrick.miller@clearlake-med.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-03-09T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Locked-down airgap: procurement clarifications & implementation plan

Patrick, Ben —

Budget note: field engineering estimate below for procurement use. These are conservative to cover validation & test cycles in an air-gapped environment:
- Kickoff & pre-install validation: 2 engineer-days (remote, pre-bundle validation)
- Onsite image transfer & install assistance: 3 engineer-days (on customer site, transfer via verified media)
- Operator handoff and runbook walkthrough: 1 engineer-day
- Patch & simulated rollback exercise: 1 engineer-day
Total: 7 engineer-days.

Pricing: $2,800/day (standard field rate) => $19,600 one-time. If ClearLake wants dedicated on-prem engineer retained for the 90-day onboarding (phone on-call), we can offer a discounted block at $15,000 for the period.

Regarding the attestation (Irene) — we will sign an attestation that the standard product has no call-home enabled out-of-the-box and that telemetry is off in air-gapped deployments unless mutually configured. Attestation will be limited to the shipped package and the documented support windows.

Laura Bennett
Head of Solutions Deployment, Redwood Inference

- "Redwood Inference attests that the standard private deployment package contains no automatic outbound telemetry in an air-gapped configuration. Any outbound support access is customer-initiated and timeboxed."
- We include a clause stating support sessions will be recorded and audit logs provided to ClearLake.
- We will provide signed SBOMs for GA releases and maintain a patch manifest for every bundle.

Please review and let us know if the language is sufficient for your procurement/legal team. Once agreed, Ben will attach to the final SOW and we'll route for signature.

Irene Choi
Senior Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
